constraints.rule: Keep MAF skills, dotagent rules, and PMCRO runtime state in separate layers.
Use typed phase messages instead of slash-command strings for agent-to-agent communication.
Webhook ingress and message queues belong to the PMCRO runtime boundary.
ACCEPT requires independent Checker evidence and a verifiable postcondition.
Delivery gates (contract, routing, replay, attempts, approval) live in the dispatcher so every transport is governed identically.
Runtime limits are read from .pmcro configuration and never accepted as caller arguments.
Any message crossing an at-least-once transport carries an idempotency_key; the dispatch ledger suppresses replays.
Control-plane scripts stay stdlib-only so validation runs where no package installs are possible.
External ingress is untrusted by default: its message carries requires_approval, and adding an origin to trusted_ingress_sources is a governance change.
Ingress records SeedIntent confidence as low; only O-Mode excavation raises it.
Contract and routing refusals dead-letter immediately; only retryable refusals consume the retry budget.
A registry carrying paths declares the base they resolve against; adapters never guess between registry root and plugin root.
Every declared envelope type resolves to a .pmcro schema; an unmapped type is a hole where untyped state re-enters.
Tool authority is declared in skill frontmatter: 'tools' is what the skill executes, 'tool_authority' is deference to the Orchestrator.
Blockers recorded in an earlier cycle are re-probed before being inherited; the environment moves.
Frames written before a contract settled are listed in legacy-frames.json, never rewritten to validate.
Offline verification runs from .pmcro/tests/run_all.py so a cycle cannot accept on a partial check.
MANIFEST.sha256 is regenerated on every tree change; the Trail is never regenerated. Integrity records and evidence records follow opposite rules.
One policy table governs a resource everywhere: the script, the editor's Write and Edit tools, and the .NET runtime all read .pmcro/policies/resource-operations.json.
A policy gate fails OPEN on its own defects and CLOSED only on policy; a guard that can break a session gets disabled, and then nothing is enforced.
Work is claimed before it starts and heartbeated after each write; a checkpoint written only at cycle end is worth nothing to a machine that stops mid-cycle.
An unreleased claim is retained as abandoned, never cleared: that a run did not finish is itself the evidence a resumer needs.
